function: build(slot: str, role: 'mining'|'validation', index: int, seed: int) -> dict

returns.cutoff_utc: ISO-8601 UTC string after every observation
returns.coverage: list of {fixture_key, from_utc, to_utc, certified_at_utc}: intervals where every receipt is known
returns.truth: list of {terminal_message_id, path_message_ids}: labelled target trajectories, terminal last
returns.counterexamples: list of {terminal_message_id, mechanism}: near misses, at least 6 mechanisms x 3 fixtures
returns.background: list of terminal_message_id of unrelated fixtures

event_fields.source: text, e.g. Stake | Betfair | Polymarket | ScanGoal
event_fields.score: [home int, away int] (required on live quotes)
